saw_lines: Nobody needs a second watch, yet people buy one to match an outfit, gift it or replace a tired one.
So the purchase is won or lost in the opening line, where a buyer decides whether the watch fits them at all.
Your ads carry no proof number across 29 copy ads, so collect one real figure, like your review count, and lead the next three ads with it.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 2 Nov 2026
points: None of your 29 copy ads carries a proof number, so a new buyer has nothing to weigh the price against. Collect one real figure, like your review count, and open the next three ads with it on the creative.
8 of 29 copy ads open on the same “10.10 sale” line, so buyers not ready for a sale get nothing else. Test two new openers: how the watch holds up daily, and a customer quote about week one.

6 winning ads have run 60+ days, yet none of the 24 newer ads reuses a winner’s opening line, so buyers meet untested hooks. Build three ads as variations of the oldest winner, keeping its opening line and swapping the product.
All 30 live ads say Shop now, yet they send buyers to 13 landing pages. A couples ad that lands on a single watch breaks its own promise. Name each button for its page, such as Shop the couples set.

ads_1: Fit and gift openers that replace the sale line, each with one proof number
soc_1: Brand social strategy across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok and YouTube
